title: A good entry level set for the new bride
text: A good entry level set for the new bride. Let's start with the pros: this is a large set with almost every kind of knife you could need (and even scissors), it's attractive and professional to look at on the countertop. Here are the cons: set is poorly made and the knives get marks/discolorations on them after several runs through the diswasher, handles feel loose and almost wobbly when using them for chopping, they only remain sharp for a short period of time (I found myself sharpening them after only two uses of dicing vegetables. I think this is a great entry level set for a bride-to-be and would look great as a relatively inexpensive shower present. However, if you are a serious cook (such as I consider myself to be) save your money and invest in a good steak knife set (which will cost over $200). It's like they say, you get what you pay for. It's attractive, but not functional.

The full tang blade extends the length of the knife to provide strength and balance. The knives are all backed by a full lifetime guarantee. This collection is perfect for cooks that are looking to save time and are ready to take cooking to the next level.
